plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for DragonWave transmission device. It reports uptime, temperature, and interface traffic, for Horizon Compact Plus and Harmony MWR (enterprise PEN 7262).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: radio_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Horizon Compact Plus radio temperature in degrees Celsius (DRAGONWAVE-HCP hzCpRadioTemperature under PEN 7262). The SNMP column reports tenths of a degree (for example 202 means 20.2 C), so the query divides the raw value by 10. The query takes the maximum across radios. High values may indicate RF hardware thermal stress.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Optional Harmony MWR system temperature in degrees Celsius (MWR-ETHERNET-MIB mwrSystemTemperature under PEN 7262). The SNMP scalar is already in whole degrees, so the query does not scale it. Horizon Compact Plus devices omit this object; missing rows are skipped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
